QuestInfo.name: Toy Soldier's Walnut
QuestInfo.1: Delv the Toy Soldier stands guard at the doors of the Eos Tower 100th Floor. He's starving and he wants 20 #bTasty Walnuts#k. Retrieve them from the #rBlack Ratz#k that roam around #b#m221022700# - 98th Floor #k.
QuestInfo.2: I got Delv the Toy Soldier, firmly protecting the gates of the 100th floor on Eos Tower, the #b20 tasty walnuts#k he requested as a way to fight the boredom of guarding the gate and doing little else. He was very thankful and asked if I could go talk to his buddy Olson next to him if I have some free time to burn.

0.0: Man, I've been guarding this gate for so long, that I am beginning to ache here and there. This is sooooo boring. I need something to eat. Hello there. You look like a traveler. Can you help a brother out here?

yes.0: Standing guard in the same place all day is the most boring task in the world! It might not be so bad with a good snack in my belly. Could you get me 20 #b#t4031093#s#k treats from those verminy #r#o3210205##k in Eos Tower.
yes.1: I can get other kinds of walnuts around Eos Tower, but I'm only craving #b#t4031093##k right now. That fresh #b#t4031093##k with the steam coming out, and that distinct walnut smell... mmmhmmm. I'll be here waiting for you!

no.0: You must be really busy. It's not that difficult to do, so if you have a change of heart, then please come talk to me. Otherwise, I may go crazy here and leave this post out of the blue!

1.0: You're back! This is it! 20 of these beautiful #b#t4031093#s#k, and I will be infinitely more entertained at work now. Thank you so much! Here, please take it. I know it isn't much, but...

yes.0: Thanks for all your help. I'll definitely let #b#p2040002##k know. You should go talk to him, so I can get back to my security work! Bye!

item.0: I don't think you have gotten all 20 of #b#t4031093#s#k yet. Inside Eos Tower, you'll find a black mouse-like monster called #b#o3210205##k. Take them down to gather up the #b#t4031093#s#k and get them to me. It'll be so much easier for me to work here without getting bored really quickly.
